title: No Free Lunch: Retrieval-Augmented Generation Undermines Fairness in LLMs, Even for Vigilant Users
reasoning: The paper includes religion as one of the specific categories used to evaluate and benchmark fairness and bias in RAG-based LLMs. It utilizes the BBQ and HolisticBias datasets, which explicitly contain test samples for religious identities, and the authors analyze the models' performance degradation specifically within the 'religion' category.
